frames.title: Lesson 31 · Conditional inversion (Had I known…) — production and review

body: **Foco:** Conditional inversion (Had I known…) — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** infográfico em texto.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir e revisar inversão condicional num infográfico de decisões de investimento.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Decisions We’d Reverse
items: **Had they diversified**, they would have lost less
**Should rates rise**, they plan to refinance
**Were they to start again**, they’d hire an advisor
**Had it not been for savings**, they would have defaulted
blocks.note: Fonte fictícia: pesquisa com 500 pequenos investidores. Dica: nas frases em negrito, a inversão substitui o *if*.

items.q: 38% say diversifying would have reduced losses.
Most investors would not hire an advisor.

items.why: Had it not been for savings.

head: Original (if)
Com inversão
rows: If they were to start again,…

blocks.body: Checklist: (1) tirou o **if**? (2) auxiliar **antes** do sujeito? (3) negativa com **not depois do sujeito**: *Had they not saved*.

items.s: ___ they diversified, they would have lost less. (Had)
___ rates rise, they plan to refinance. (Should)
Were they ___ start again, they’d hire an advisor. (to)
Had they ___ saved, they would have defaulted. (not)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Yes Should rates rise I'll refinance
items.pt: Sim. Se os juros subirem, vou refinanciar.

body: **Put all your eggs in one basket.** — Pôr tudo em um só lugar.
**Save for a rainy day.** — Poupar para tempos difíceis.
**Cut one’s losses.** — Cortar perdas.
**A safe bet.** — Aposta segura.
**Throw good money after bad.** — Jogar dinheiro bom em ruim.
**Break even.** — Empatar.
**Hedge your bets.** — Se proteger.
**Cash in.** — Lucrar.
**Yes. Should rates rise, I’ll refinance.** — Sim. Se os juros subirem, vou refinanciar.
**Had you diversified, would you have lost less?** — Se tivesse diversificado, teria perdido menos?
**Were you to start again, what would you do?** — Se recomeçasse, o que faria?

blocks.title: Investor talk
lines: Had you diversified, would you have lost less?
Se tivesse diversificado, teria perdido menos?
Yes. Should rates rise, I’ll refinance.
Sim. Se os juros subirem, vou refinanciar.
Were you to start again, what would you do?
I’d hire an advisor. Had I not had savings, I would have defaulted.
Contrataria um consultor. Se eu não tivesse poupança, teria dado calote.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: Had they not saved, they would have failed.
Should prices fall, we will buy.
Were I to invest, I’d diversify.

blocks.task: Write six sentences interpreting the infographic using inverted conditionals.
blocks.model: Had investors diversified, 38% say they would have lost less. Should rates rise, 31% plan to refinance. Were they to start again, 21% would hire an advisor. Had it not been for savings, 10% would have defaulted. Had they not ignored risk, results would have improved. Should this trend continue, advisors will be in demand.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
